summary: The hybrid worker is better protected, and PIM Manager can now report status and take Pro updates from Invardia.

new.title: Status reports to Invardia (optional)
new.text: PIM Manager can report job results hourly and its version daily, so support sees a failure before you call. Switch it on under Settings > Features.

new.title: Pro updates from Invardia (optional)
new.text: A Pro installation can take signed releases for its ring from Invardia, checked before anything moves. Switch it on under Settings > Features.

new.title: Ready script for the hub network owner
new.text: For a private installation, setup writes the script the hub network team runs to create their side of the connection.

fixes.title: Safer database administrator group
fixes.text: Setup now only makes a role-assignable group the database administrator. Otherwise it keeps the current one and says how to recreate the group.

fixes.title: Hybrid worker without a public address
fixes.text: The hybrid worker now only connects outward, and nothing can open a connection to it.
fixes.action: On a hybrid worker installed earlier, run the hybrid worker outbound setup once; it keeps the same address.

fixes.title: Admin updates no longer fail after removals
fixes.text: A run whose changes were already made no longer fails on its follow-up steps; you get a warning instead.
